scenarios.title: Future eligibility enrollment uses Eligibility Date as transaction effective date
Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed uses Assessment Date
gaps: TC_001 also requires "2) Current eligibility with multiple Assessment Dates in the file uses the first Assessment Date (Loop 2300 HD03) as transaction effective date."; add a dedicated test case for it

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with Assessment Date changed and relevant fields unchanged preserves fields

flagged.why: too few steps for required flow

gaps: TC_002 has 18 steps, but duplicates TC_003 on the same shared intent: both validate 'Assessment Date changed and relevant fields unchanged updates transaction effective date while preserving fields' for a single discriminating field variant; the quoted intents are Test Case Name 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility update uses Assessment Date as transaction effective date when Rate Cell remains unchanged' and Test Case Name 'Verify AR PASSE current eligibility update uses Assessment Date as transaction effective date when Pregnancy remains unchanged'.

Description lists un-covered conditions in field Description: 'Conditions to cover: 1) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged and Assessment Number remains unchanged. 2) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged and Assessment Tier remains unchanged. 3) Assessment Date changes while the relevant fields are unchanged and Assessment Division remains unchanged.'; add dedicated test cases for those listed conditions.

Step Description field contains "Populate unique ISA13, GS06, GE02, and IEA02 values for this execution and place TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834 in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound, then confirm pickup and archive in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\AR." which contradicts hint line "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case." and the established archive usage elsewhere in the table uses "\\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\CSAR" for the same AR PASSE flow.

scenarios.title: Current eligibility with unchanged Assessment Date and relevant-field changes uses Maintenance Date

flagged.why: too few steps for required flow
too few steps for required flow
wrong server for FACETS SQL step

gaps: TC_002 has 18 steps, but step 4 compresses the required atomic flow into one step: "Place TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834 into \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound, confirm pickup from staging, and confirm archival in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\State_of_AR." Field: Step Description. This contradicts hint: "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

TC_003 has 18 steps, but step 4 compresses the required atomic flow into one step: "Place TP028433_E2026031_123456789.834 in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTRoot\834\Inbound, verify automatic pickup, and verify archival in \\daycrtappfs01\EdifecsSTArchive\834\Inbound\State_of_AR." Field: Step Description. This contradicts hint: "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case."

Offending table text in Step Description: "On crt_69.sql.caresource.corp\crt_69 run the auxiliary span lookup query SELECT * FROM NRTCUSTOMDB.Facets.AuxiliarySpanLookup WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE KEY_ID IN (20,73,23,47,37,46);" Field: Step Description. Contradicted hint: "Every test case walks the complete end-to-end flow at full atomic depth - file creation with the resolved literal file name, staging, pickup, archive, TM UI verification with status values, canonical file and GUID validation, FACETS SQL validation, and the Facets client lookup - at 18 steps minimum; do not compress the flow in any case." The same test case uses NRTCUSTOMDB on crt_69 for steps 18-19 while earlier NRTCUSTOMDB validations are on crt_72, creating inconsistent domain-hint alignment for FACETS SQL flow.

Scenario description requires separate conditions: "4) Aid Category changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 5) Rate Cell changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun. 6) Pregnancy changes while Assessment Date is unchanged and eligibility has already begun." Field: scenario description. Most closely related test case is TC_005, but TC_005 covers only "change all relevant fields together: Assessment Number, Assessment Tier, Assessment Division, Aid Category, Rate Cell, and Pregnancy." Field: Pre-condition. TS_005 also requires dedicated test cases for Aid Category-only, Rate Cell-only, and Pregnancy-only changes; add a dedicated test case for each missing condition.

scenarios.title: Regression confirms restricted Maintenance Date usage and no adverse finance impact
gaps: Coverage gap attached to TC_001: scenario description field says "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)." Add a dedicated test case for the quoted clause.

Coverage gap attached to TC_002: full acceptance criteria text says "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the Assessment Date has changed and none of the relevant fields have changed, the Assessment Date populates as the transaction effective date, maintaining values of relevant fields." Add a dedicated test case for the quoted clause.

Coverage gap attached to TC_003: full acceptance criteria text says "Given an inbound EDI 834 file, if the member’s eligibility span has not yet begun and any relevant fields have changed but Assessment Date has NOT changed, the Eligibility Date populates as the transaction effective date." Add a dedicated test case for the quoted clause.

scenarios.title: Existing date identification and population capability remains backward compatible
gaps: TC_001 also requires "1) Existing functionality continues to identify Effective Date in the inbound EDI 834 file."; add a dedicated test case for it

Field "Test Case Name" contains "Verify AR PASSE inbound 834 continues to identify the Maintenance Date and populate the transaction effective date from Maintenance Date" while no test case covers "2) Existing functionality continues to identify Assessment Date (Loop 2300 HD03) in the inbound EDI 834 file."

Field "Pre-condition" contains "the file containing a populated Maintenance Date in Loop 2000 DTP*303 for the member under test." which contradicts hint "Coverage follows the programme's manual matrix for this story: (Assessment Date changed vs not changed) x (existing member vs future eligibility) x relevant-field variations - including MULTI-FIELD COMBINATIONS as their own conditions (e.g. Assessment Number + Tier + Division together, and an All Relevant Fields Updated condition per quadrant)."
